The evidence indicates that P-Cresol may influence the activity of dTDP-4-dehydrorhamnose 3,5-epimerase, potentially modulating the function of 7-O-Methylgarcinone and ultimately affecting the activity of Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B3. The strength of this relationship is supported by the final score of 0.568, suggesting a moderate to strong association.
